name: video-wisdom-site
description: Static site for VideoWisdom extracted insights — organized by speaker & category, built from markdown

scripts.dev: (node src/build-video-site.js || bun src/build-video-site.js) && npx serve dist -p 3000
scripts.postinstall: pip install -q --break-system-packages faster-whisper yt-dlp --cache-dir ./.cache/pip 2>&1 | tail -n 5; mkdir -p ./.cache/huggingface; mkdir -p ./.cache/npm
